source.title: Odie - Desert Defender
source.name: Odie
source.description: A Marksman who is skilled at war of attrition and dealing continuous damage.

skills.name: Corrosive Dart

description.raw: Odie fires a Corrosive Dart, dealing 150% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage and Dart Poison to an enemy. The poisoned target will receive 30% (ATK-based) damage every second until defeated. Dart Poison cannot be dispelled.
active: Odie fires a Corrosive Dart, dealing 150% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage and Dart Poison to an enemy.
The poisoned target will receive 30% (ATK-based) damage every second until defeated.

text: Gains 600 Energy when a poisoned enemy is defeated, but only 200 Energy if the enemy is a summoned unit.

skills.description_lite: Odie deals continuous damage to an enemy.

skills.name: Triple Tap

description.raw: Odie deals 60% (ATK-based) + 5% (SP-based) damage to an enemy 3 times. The attacks from this skill are considered normal attacks.
active: Odie deals 60% (ATK-based) + 5% (SP-based) damage to an enemy 3 times.
The attacks from this skill are considered normal attacks.

skills.description_lite: Odie deals triple-shot normal attacks to an enemy.

skills.name: Venom Surge

description.raw: Odie prioritizes launching normal attacks at the nearest poisoned target. When the normal attacks hit a poisoned target, the base damage of the target's Dart Poison is permanently increased by 25% (ATK-based), up to 20 + 2 (SP-based) stacks.
active: Odie prioritizes launching normal attacks at the nearest poisoned target.
When the normal attacks hit a poisoned target, the base damage of the target's Dart Poison is permanently increased by 25% (ATK-based), up to 20 + 2 (SP-based) stacks.

text: Increases the range of normal attacks and Ultimate to 7 tiles.
Increases Dart Poison's base damage to 27%
Increases Dart Poison's base damage to 29%

skills.description_lite: Odie increases Dart Poison damage over time with each normal attack that hits the poisoned target.

description.raw: Increases ATK SPD by 21 during battle.
active: Increases ATK SPD by 21 during battle.

text: Increases ATK SPD by 27 during battle.
Increases ATK SPD by 33 during battle.

skills.name: Heart Crusher

description.raw: Odie immediately defeats poisoned enemies when their HP drops below a threshold equal to 5.2 times the base damage dealt by Dart Poison per second. Each time a poisoned enemy is defeated, the threshold is increased by 0.5 times the base damage dealt by Dart Poison per second, up to 2 times.
active: Odie immediately defeats poisoned enemies when their HP drops below a threshold equal to 5.2 times the base damage dealt by Dart Poison per second.
Each time a poisoned enemy is defeated, the threshold is increased by 0.5 times the base damage dealt by Dart Poison per second, up to 2 times.

text: Increases the threshold to 5.7 times the base damage dealt by Dart Poison per second.
Increases the threshold to 6.2 times the base damage dealt by Dart Poison per second.

skills.description_lite: Odie immediately defeats poisoned targets when their HP is too low.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Odie increases Triple Tap's damage against poisoned target by 1.5 times the Dart Poison damage per second.
active: Odie increases Triple Tap's damage against poisoned target by 1.5 times the Dart Poison damage per second.

skills.description_lite: Odie increases Triple Tap's damage when hitting a poisoned target.
